title: Neuro and MSK: brain MRI sequences, spine levels, mammogram mass
description: Pre-operative brain MRI of one glioma patient (3D T1 post-contrast, axial T2 BLADE, axial FLAIR) with tumour, ventricle and cerebrum DICOM SEGs (ReMIND); one spine CT with vertebral-level segmentation T1-L5 for level identification (Spine-Mets-CT-SEG); one CBIS-DDSM craniocaudal film-screen mammogram with the source ROI mask and source-stated pathology.

provenanceDetail.source: tcia:ReMIND (The Brain Resection Multimodal Imaging Database (ReMIND), doi:10.7937/3RAG-D070)
provenanceDetail.method: DICOM SEG (BINARY) read with highdicom; reference series via SEG has no ReferencedSeriesSequence; reference series taken from selection.json (SEG SeriesDescription 'tumor seg - MR ref: 3D_AX_T1_postcontrast') and verified by identical FrameOfReferenceUID; frames mapped to source SOP via DerivationImageSequence/SourceImageSequence (0 frame(s)) and PlanePositionSequence match to the nearest source slice within half the slice spacing (57); 0 unmatched, 0 empty frame(s). Max SEG-frame to source-slice distance 0.0001 mm. Even-odd holes: 4.
provenanceDetail.note: Segment 1 'Glioma'; SegmentedPropertyType 'Glioma' (SCT 115240006); category 'Morphologically Altered Structure'; SegmentAlgorithmType MANUAL; SEG SOPInstanceUID 1.3.6.1.4.1.14519.5.2.1.104443907484537090447979014296849483791; ContentCreatorName ''. referenceTargets.unassessedNote: Only the segments in this DICOM SEG are referenced (Glioma (tumour)); all other anatomy and findings are unassessed.
referenceTargets.teachingNote: ReMIND pre-operative segmentation defined on the 3D T1 post-contrast series (frames resampled/cropped by the source and mapped back to the T1 slices through patient coordinates).
